name: Antigravity (Google DeepMind)
limitationsNote: Full access. Uses AMS natively. Primary benchmark agent.

name: OpenAI Codex / GPT-4o
limitationsNote: Can read AMS memory files. Context window limit means large repos require memory compression.

name: Claude Code (Anthropic)
limitationsNote: 200k context. Excellent at reading structured markdown memory files. Recommended for cross-session benchmarks.

name: VS Code GitHub Copilot Agent
limitationsNote: Limited context window. AMS memory files provide the largest benefit here.

name: Cursor AI Agent
limitationsNote: Simulated via proxy measurement. Cursor's codebase indexing may overlap with AMS scope partially.

name: Gemini CLI Agent
limitationsNote: 1M context window. Least benefit from token reduction, but benefits significantly from structured navigation hints.

name: Simulated Baseline Agent
limitationsNote: Automated simulation representing a typical GPT-4-class agent with no persistent memory. Used for automated benchmark runs.
